remarks: PRICE REDUCED! Build your dream home in the heart of the highly desirable Sandy Beach community on Grand Island. This buildable vacant lot offers a rare opportunity to enjoy one of the area's most sought-after neighborhoods. Property owners are eligible to join the Sandy Beach Park Club for an annual fee, providing access to a private lifeguarded beach, boat launch, optional boat slips, fishing, basketball and volleyball courts, horseshoe pits, picnic gazebo with grill, and a beautifully upgraded sandy shoreline. Outdoor enthusiasts will appreciate the close proximity to Buckhorn Island State Park, featuring scenic hiking trails and kayak access. Also conveniently located near Huth Road Elementary School, this exceptional lot combines a desirable location with outstanding recreational amenities and boating privileges. Please do not walk the lot without permission.
